summary: Tyson Foods filed an 8-K reporting early tender results and pricing for cash tender offers for its 3.550% Senior Notes due 2027, 5.400% Senior Notes due 2029, and 4.350% Senior Notes due 2029. The offers, commenced August 10, 2026, are subject to acceptance priority levels, a maximum tender cap, a 2027 sub-cap, and pro rata allocation. Early settlement is set for August 26, 2026. The company also amended terms of the offers. This is a debt buyback, not an equity special situation. Watch for final acceptance and any impact on leverage; risk-arb angle is minimal as it is a liability management exercise.
